name: Dr.Babasaheb Ambedkar Udyog Uday Yojana: Assistance to MSEs for Shed Developed by Private Developer
benefit: - **Financial Assistance:** Private developers receive an additional 15% assistance on the total cost of the shed.  - **Government Support:** SC/ST entrepreneurs need to pay only 30% of the shed price, after which possession is handed over, and developers can claim assistance.  - **Subsidized Costs:** The government disburses 35% of the shed cost after the sale and the remaining amount after produ
_eligibility_text:
1. The firm must be a Micro/Small/Medium enterprise run by SC/ST entrepreneur.
   1. The shed must be located in a government-approved mini estate.
   1. The entrepreneur must pay 30% of the shed cost to acquire possession.

&gt; **Note****:** 

  - **SC/ST Enterprise:** SC/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more.
